summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing an ASX Appendix 2A application to quote 68,107 new ordinary fully paid shares issued upon vesting of 101,573 employee performance rights. The shares rank equally with existing ordinary shares. No cash consideration was received. The filing is a routine administrative quotation application, not a special situation. It reflects employee incentive scheme activity only; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is involved. Watch for potential minor share-count dilution and any further Appendix 2A filings.
